title: Correct motion (rigid)
description: Aligns every frame to a reference image by the whole-pixel shift that maximises their phase correlation, and saves the aligned stack and the shifts. The reference is the average of the first frames; each further iteration uses the average of the frames aligned in the one before. Pixels shifted in from outside the frame are 0. In a stack with channels, the shifts are found in one channel and every channel is aligned by them; in one with planes, one plane is aligned (as height x width x channels x frames).

stack.title: Stack
stack.description: Variable that holds the image stack (height x width x frames).

output.title: Aligned stack
output.description: Variable the result is saved to.

shiftsOutput.title: Shifts
shiftsOutput.description: Variable the shifts are saved to: frames x 2 integers, the rows and columns each frame was displaced from the reference (aligning moves it back). Leave empty to not save it.

channel.title: Reference channel
channel.description: Of a stack with channels: the one the shifts are found in, from 1. Every channel is aligned by them

plane.title: Plane
plane.description: Of a stack with planes: the one to align, from 1
